review_policy: severe-artifact veto first, then visibly stylized film-inspired appeal
observations: The denser rendering is consistently preferred on foliage, water, branches, pylons, buildings and village scenes because the pale alternative often adds a cyan or pink veil.
The lifted magenta castle rendering is preferred over the very dark alternative because it restores visible subject separation without a severe structural defect.
No option is rejected for severe geometry, text, object, banding, seam, clipping-block or repeated-texture corruption at contact-sheet scale.
claim_ceiling: Autonomous blind visual evidence on a third modern-camera OOD contact-sheet population; not population preference, full-resolution universal safety, stock response, calibration or product promotion.
